# LibGuides at Kent State University

> > Comprehensive research guides and library resources for Kent State University students and faculty, powered by Springshare's LibGuides platform.

Kent State University Libraries operates an extensive LibGuides system providing subject-specific research guides, tutorial resources, citation tools, and facility information. The platform serves as a central hub for academic research support and library services across the university.

## Key Topics

- Kent State University

- research resources

## Core Navigation & Directories

- [Home - LibGuides at Kent State University](https://libguides.library.kent.edu): Kent State University Libraries LibGuides homepage and guide directory
- [Subjects - LibGuides at Kent State University](https://libguides.library.kent.edu/sb.php): Subject guide directory for research resources at Kent State Libraries
- [A-Z Databases](https://libguides.library.kent.edu/az.php): Alphabetical directory of Kent State University Libraries databases

## Learning & Research Support

- [Home - Library Tutorials - LibGuides at Kent State University](https://libguides.library.kent.edu/tutorials): Kent State University Libraries tutorial directory and learning resources
- [Home - Citation Tools - LibGuides at Kent State University](https://libguides.library.kent.edu/citationtools): Guide to citation styles and tools for academic writing at Kent State
- [Welcome - Academic Integrity - LibGuides at Kent State University](https://libguides.library.kent.edu/plagiarism): Guide to academic integrity and plagiarism prevention at Kent State

## Subject & Specialized Resources

- [Home - Government Information at Kent State University Libraries - LibGuides at Kent State University](https://libguides.library.kent.edu/Government): Guide to government documents and information resources at Kent State

## Library Facilities & Services

- [Scheduling & Use Guidelines - Library Instructional Spaces - LibGuides at Kent State University](https://libguides.library.kent.edu/instructional-spaces): Guide for scheduling and using Kent State library instructional spaces
- [Home - Study Spaces - LibGuides at Kent State University](https://libguides.library.kent.edu/studyspaces): Guide to study spaces and facility locations at Kent State Libraries
